rationale: The dictionary has no country variable; the code (BOL) is a constant set by the harmonizer rather than derived from a raw variable.
No survey year variable exists; the year (2017) appears only in question text (e.g., 'este 2017'), so it must be set as a constant.
No interview month variable is present; the month variables (s03a_03a, s04b_14a) refer to residence and birth dates, not the interview.
depto is the department, which is the first-level administrative division of Bolivia.
area codes 1=urban and 2=rural, so it is recoded to 1=urban and 0=rural.
folio is the household identifier shared by all members.
nro is the person number within the household.
Only one expansion factor (factor) exists, so it is used for the household weight.
factor is the only expansion factor and applies to person-level records.
upm is the primary sampling unit variable.
The 'estrato' variable is the statistical geographic stratum of the sample design.
s02a_05 gives the relationship to the household head and its codes can be recoded into head, spouse, child, other relative, non-relative and domestic worker.
s02a_02 records sex directly, with 1=man and 2=woman.
s02a_03 records age in completed years.
s02a_10 gives marital status: single, married or cohabiting go to union, separated or divorced are grouped, and widowed stays separate.
s03a_04 asks about belonging to an indigenous or Afro-Bolivian people and s03a_04npioc names the people, so indigenous, afro-descendant and other can be derived.
Disability can be flagged from the functional difficulty items (mainly 'much difficulty' or 'cannot do' responses), optionally combined with the disability card in s04a_08a.
s03a_01a gives residence five years ago (abroad = 3) and s03a_01e gives the country, which identifies recent international migrants only, not all foreign-born people.

The derived 'condact' labor-force status can be recoded to employed, unemployed (cesante or aspirante) and inactive, with age (s02a_03) defining below working age, and the raw activity, search and availability questions can verify it.
s06b_16 gives the employment category in the main occupation (worker, employee, own-account, employer, unpaid family, domestic worker), which maps to the target categories.
Main-job occupation code (s06b_11a_cod) or the precomputed occupational group cob_op can be recoded into the 9 IDB groups.
Main-job economic activity code (s06b_12a_cod) or the precomputed CAEB group caeb_op can be mapped to the IDB industry groups.
phrs gives weekly hours in the main job; alternatively compute days per week (s06b_22) times average daily hours (s06b_23aa/ab).
tothrs is the total weekly hours across jobs, equal to phrs plus shrs.
Number of persons working in the firm (s06b_21 or the bracketed s06b_21a) is recoded into small/medium/large.
Administration type in main job: codes 1 (public administration) and 2 (public enterprise) indicate the public sector.
s06b_17 records the contract type (fixed-term, verbal agreement, permanent post, no contract) in the main job.
The survey asks about AFP affiliation (s06h_58b) but not whether the person is currently contributing; the only related job-benefit item is health insurance (s06c_29b).
s06h_58b asks whether the person is affiliated to an AFP (pension fund), the closest social security affiliation measure.
yprilab is the precomputed monthly main-job labor income; it can also be rebuilt from salary (s06c_25a/b) or total income (s06d_31a/b) with periodicity.

In-kind benefits from the main job (food, transport, clothing, housing, other) with frequency and amounts; the dictionary does not state the amount semantics clearly for the amount fields, so the mapping is moderately confident.
Monetary income from the second job: salary or total income with periodicity, plus the net amount left for the household for self-employed workers; overtime/bonus amounts are also reported.
The survey provides precomputed labor income (ylab = main + secondary), which includes monetary and some in-kind components, so total monetary labor income is only approximated from it.
In-kind payments from the main job (food, transport, clothing, housing, other) plus second-job in-kind amounts (food/transport/clothing, housing) make up non-monetary labor income.
Non-labor income covers pensions, Renta Dignidad, interest, rents, dividends, indemnities, family assistance, transfers and remittances; ynolab gives the precomputed total.
Contributory pension income comes from retirement, benemérito, disability and widow/orphan pensions; Renta Dignidad is non-contributory and excluded.
Remittances from abroad with frequency, amount and currency; the in-kind valuation (s07c_10) can be added.
Tenure status identifies owner-occupied housing, and s01a_05 gives the self-reported rent the household would pay, which serves as the imputed rent.
z is the official poverty line in Bs per person per month.
zext is the official extreme poverty line in Bs per person per month.
Current attendance is s05b_10 (1=asiste), conditional on having enrolled this year (s05a_05); cmasi also encodes it.
The survey provides a precomputed years-of-education variable (aestudio), which can be rebuilt from the highest level and grade approved (s05a_02a, s05a_02b).
s05a_09 states whether the establishment of enrollment is public (1=Fiscal/Público/Convenio) or private, asked of those enrolled.
Piped water access comes from the drinking water source: codes 1 and 2 (piped network inside the dwelling or within the lot) vs. others.
s01a_10 gives the main source of drinking water, to be recoded to the harmonized categories.
s01a_19 asks whether electric energy is used to light the dwelling (1=yes, 2=no).
Sanitation type is s01a_15, refined by drainage destination (s01a_16) and whether shared (s01a_17).
s01a_09 gives the main floor material of the dwelling, with an 'other' specification in s01a_09e.
s01a_06 gives the main wall construction material, with an 'other' specification in s01a_06e.
s01a_08 gives the main roof material, with an 'other' specification in s01a_08e.
s01a_28 asks how many of the rooms the household uses exclusively for sleeping.
s01a_27 gives the number of rooms the household occupies, excluding bathroom, kitchen and similar spaces.
s01a_02 gives dwelling tenure: owned (1, 2) maps to 1, rented (3, and possibly 4 or 5) to 0, and loaned, ceded or other (6, 7, 8) to 3.
s01a_31 asks whether the household has internet access in the dwelling.

There is no household-level mobile phone item. The best proxy is the individual question s05c_13 (used a cell phone in the last 3 months), collapsed to household level with any member answering yes. Household spending on mobile service in s10b_10_26 could also be used.
The durable goods module lists the item (5=Computadora) with s10c_14 recording whether the household has it.
The durable goods module lists the item (4=Refrigerador/freezer) with s10c_14 recording whether the household has it.
The durable goods module lists the item (11=Automóvil para uso del hogar) with s10c_14 recording whether the household has it.
